sources.title: Tutkinto-opiskelijaksi hakeminen yhteishaussa - SAMK
sources.covers: Checked: points to Vipunen (vipunen.fi/fi-fi/amk/Sivut/Hakeneet-ja-hyväksytyt.aspx) for past statistics; no own cutoff list

sources.title: Valintaperusteet kevät 2026 yhteishaku II - SAMK
sources.covers: Selection criteria only (scoring, schedules); not cutoff results

notes: SAMK does not publish its own lowest-accepted-score statistics. Its joint-application page sends applicants to Opetushallitus's Vipunen for earlier-year statistics. Searched: WebSearch in Finnish (pisterajat, alin hyväksytty, valintatilasto, alimmat pisteet, samk.fi/app/uploads), a scan of the full samk.fi sitemap (about 1,215 URLs) for piste/tilasto/alin/valintatulos/todistus, and the hakeminen pages and applicant-count news items (only totals, no cutoffs). No 2024-2026 spring or autumn cutoff document was found.
